notes.title: Golel Demo now available.
notes.content:
Please try out the Demo of Golel.

Golel is a first person Dungeon Crawler that can run on lower end PCs.
It is elaborating on turn based tactical combat in a way that hasn't been done a lot before.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577730/Golel/

notes.title: Try out Golden Fall 2 Demo.
notes.content:
Golden Fall 2 is an RPG with Roguelike time based movement.
When you move your character, the entire world moves with you.

Play the Demo as one of 3 characters, select attributes, gain equipment, weapons and armor. Learn skills and spells. Fight monsters, find hidden secrets and talk with the memorable characters.

Please try out the Golden Fall 2 Demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292410/Golden_Fall_2/

[previewyoutube=B4XfdTBHM5k;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Next goal for the developer.
notes.content:
A small update fixed a few bugs and disabled the online gameplay because it was unstable.

However, the next goal would be bringing back the interesting Neural Network based AI, instead of the existing simple AI.

In the original game there was an NN based AI and people commented it's one of the best AIs they have seen for this type of game.

I hope to bring the AI magic back.

notes.title: Improved AI, the computer is getting harder to beat. Oh my.
notes.content:
In version 1.035 the AI will be harder to beat. It avoids projectiles better.

A few other updates since launch:
Red flashing light when hit, was missing by mistake.
Saving sound settings global(remembers your settings from the last play session).
Updated shooting rate of "kings".


I hope to improve the AI, and improve the online match. Possible there will be a score board for the online matches to see who is the best!
